problem: User revise at Gate 3 (second time). Closing the text editor after styling a range adds an empty undo entry. Reproduced: text created with the text tool, reopened, highlight applied over 0..5, editor exited: undoStack 1 -> 2 on the highlight -> 3 on exit; the first undo is a no-op, the second clears textRanges. Baseline (reopen and exit with no change) leaves the stack at 1. Cause: in updateElement (lines ~228-252), the scene.replaceAllElements map calls shiftTextRangesOnEdit(_element.textRanges, _element.originalText, nextOriginalText) even when the text is unchanged; it then returns normalizeTextRanges(...), a NEW array, and newElementWith treats a new reference as a change, bumping the version, so the store records an empty entry. Fix: when nextOriginalText === _element.originalText (and not isDeleted), do NOT call shiftTextRangesOnEdit; keep _element.textRanges as is (same reference, or simply don't pass a textRanges key so newElementWith keeps it). Keep the `delete (nextElement as Mutable<ExcalidrawTextElement>).textRanges` of an emptied textRanges for the changed-text (and isDeleted) path only, so an unchanged-text update never deletes or replaces the existing textRanges. Change nothing else in the file; eslint --max-warnings=0 must pass and every existing test must still pass.
